#include <stdlib.h>
struct Node{int value;struct Node*next;};struct Node*build(int count,unsigned char bias){struct Node*head=0;for(int i=0;i<count;i++){struct Node*p=calloc(1,sizeof(struct Node));if(!p){return head;}p->value=i+bias;p->next=head;head=p;}return head;}long long entry(int n,int delta){struct Node*head=build(n+1,delta+260);long long total=0;while(head){struct Node*tail=head->next;total+=head->value;free(head);head=tail;}return total;}

#include <stdlib.h>
struct Node{int value;struct Node*next;};struct Node*build(int count,int bias){struct Node*head=0;for(int i=0;i<count;i++){struct Node*p=calloc(1,sizeof(struct Node));if(!p){return head;}p->value=i+bias;p->next=head;head=p;}return head;}long long entry(int n,int delta){struct Node*head=build((unsigned char)(n+260),delta+1);long long total=0;while(head){struct Node*tail=head->next;total+=head->value;free(head);head=tail;}return total;}

#include <stdlib.h>
struct Node{int value;struct Node*next;};struct Node*build(int count,signed char bias){struct Node*head=0;for(int i=0;i<count;i++){struct Node*p=calloc(1,sizeof(struct Node));if(!p){return head;}p->value=i+bias;p->next=head;head=p;}return head;}long long entry(int n,int delta){struct Node*head=build(n+1,delta+255);long long total=0;while(head){struct Node*tail=head->next;total+=head->value;free(head);head=tail;}return total;}

#include <stdlib.h>

#include <stdlib.h>
struct Node{int value;struct Node*next;};struct Node*build(int count,unsigned char bias){struct Node*head=0;for(int i=0;i<count;i++){struct Node*p=calloc(1,sizeof(struct Node));if(!p){return head;}p->value=i+bias;p->next=head;head=p;}return head;}void map(struct Node*q,int d){while(q){q->value=q->value+d;q=q->next;}}struct Node*flip(struct Node*head){struct Node*prev=0;while(head){struct Node*next=head->next;head->next=prev;prev=head;head=next;}return prev;}long long entry(int n,int delta){struct Node*head=build(n+1,delta+260);map(head,delta);head=flip(head);long long total=0;while(head){struct Node*tail=head->next;total+=head->value;free(head);head=tail;}return total;}

#include <stdlib.h>
struct Node{int value;struct Node*next;};struct Node*build(int count,unsigned char bias){struct Node*head=0;for(int i=0;i<count;i++){struct Node*p=calloc(1,sizeof(struct Node));if(!p){return head;}p->value=i+bias;p->next=head;head=p;}return head;}struct Node*entry(int n,int delta){struct Node*head=build(n+1,delta+260);return head;}

request.source:
#include <stdlib.h>
struct Node{int value;struct Node*next;};struct Node*build(int count,unsigned char bias){struct Node*head=0;for(int i=0;i<count;i++){struct Node*p=calloc(1,sizeof(struct Node));if(!p){break;}p->value=i+bias;p->next=head;head=p;}struct Node*cursor=head;while(cursor){cursor->value=cursor->value+1;cursor=cursor->next;}return head;}long long entry(int n,int delta){struct Node*head=build(n+1,delta+260);long long total=0;while(head){struct Node*tail=head->next;total+=head->value;free(head);head=tail;}return total;}
